blocks.title: The everyday apps, rebuilt.
blocks.lead: Each core app follows the same rules: the app’s own colour on its main header, plain sub pages, a bottom toolbar with Back on the left, squircle icons and light, large type.

items.title: Contacts
items.text: People first: squircle photos, one list, every way to reach someone on their card.

items.title: Messaging
items.text: Conversations in N9 bubbles. Inline reply from Events is an optional extra.

items.title: Mail
items.text: A calm inbox with the N9 view menu: Inbox, Sent, Drafts and folders from the title.

items.title: Calendar
items.text: Month, week and agenda views; today’s entries also appear in Events.

items.title: Music
items.text: Library and now playing, with a Belle-style music widget planned for the home screen.

items.title: Gallery
items.text: Photos as they are, edge to edge, with sharing from the toolbar.

items.title: Store
items.text: Apps in the same visual language as the rest of the system.

items.title: Clock
items.text: Alarms, world clock, timers and stopwatch behind one bottom toolbar.

items.title: Feeds
items.text: The sources you follow, delivered into the Feeds section of Events.

items.title: Settings
items.text: Every stock option, N9 lists, and pull-down to search instead of a search button.

items.label: Open the interactive phone
items.text: Unlock it and tap an app.
